::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/integrations/hubspot/sync"}
#docs
`full: true` re-pushes every record instead of only what changed.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is optional.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `full` | `boolean` | no | True to sync every record; false to sync only what changed. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `queued` | `boolean` | True if a sync was queued. |
| `full` | `boolean` | Whether the queued sync covers every record. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `202` | Queued |
| `404` | HubSpot is not connected |
| `409` | The first sync has not been started yet |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/integrations/hubspot/sync" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "full": false
  }'
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [202 Accepted]
{
  "object": "hubspot_sync",
  "queued": false,
  "full": false
}
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "HubSpot is not connected"
  }
}
```
```json [409 Conflict]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "conflict_error",
    "message": "The first sync has not been started yet"
  }
}
```
:::
